verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on Linear's performance in workspaces with tens of thousands of issues, and nothing on any issue or item caps. Community remarks about Linear feeling faster than Jira come from small teams and say nothing about large-scale workspaces. The published API rate limits cover request throughput, not workspace item caps, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
